items.headline: Coastal Flood Watch issued October 16 at 2:55PM EDT until October 20 at 8:00AM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Watch, 2 to 4 feet of inundation
above ground level possible in low-lying areas near shorelines
and tidal waterways. For the High Surf Advisory, large breaking
waves of 6 to 9 feet expected in the surf zone.

* WHERE...Ocracoke Island.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Watch, from Saturday afternoon
through Tuesday morning. For the High Surf Advisory, from
midnight Saturday night to 8 PM EDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...2 to 4 feet of inundation above ground level is
possible in some areas near shorelines and tidal waterways
resulting in an elevated threat of property damage. Flooding
will extend inland from the waterfront threatening some homes
and businesses. Numerous road closures and flooding of vehicles
will be possible. Vulnerable portions of NC-12 may be inundated,
especially around high tide. Dangerous swimming and surfing
conditions and localized beach erosion.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...This has the potential to be a long
duration event bringing more significant ocean overwash impacts
to vulnerable oceanside areas through multiple high tide cycles
into next week. Minor soundside water level rises will also be
possible.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

Inexperienced swimmers should remain out of the water due to
dangerous surf conditions.

items.headline: High Wind Watch issued October 16 at 2:18PM EDT until October 19 at 2:00AM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts up to 50 mph possible.

* WHERE...East Carteret County, and Hatteras Island, Northern Outer
Banks, and Ocracoke Island.

* WHEN...From Saturday evening through late Sunday night.

* IMPACTS...Damaging winds could blow down trees and power lines.
Widespread power outages are possible. Travel could be difficult,
especially for high profile vehicles.
items.instruction:
Monitor the latest forecasts and warnings for updates.

Fasten loose objects or shelter objects in a safe location prior to
the onset of winds.

items.headline: Gale Warning issued October 16 at 2:29PM EDT until October 20 at 9:00AM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds 25 to 35 kt with gusts up to 45 kt and seas
13 to 18 ft expected.

* WHERE...The coastal waters from Oregon Inlet to Ocracoke Inlet.

* WHEN...From 1 PM Saturday to 9 AM EDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Some potential exists for gusts up to 50
kt..
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
